description: Fixed DURA-free joint learned channel and observation-conditioned unrolled IQ restoration with frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL.
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 CPU two threads, CUDA disabled; exact frozen source model and same fixed evaluation

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: Blind action posterior plus three observation/learned prior updates; no DURA in candidate
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: No source true identity labels, simulated channel truth, U_s truth, V or test in this validation; clean-F pseudo labels only
data.validation_ref: 7840 RX4/6 source validation and 3921 RX8 source holdout IDs, all physical IDs previously observed in other views; frozen clean F pseudo labels only

permissions.query_use: Source clean F high-confidence pseudo targets only; no TX labels, U_s truth, V or test.
permissions.claim_scope: Post-hoc source validation replay, F pseudo labels not truth; original source IDs and results previously explored; not independent blind test

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen independent blind action, source Gaussian prior, source-trained channel regressor and source-trained three-step observation-conditioned corrector; fixed gate .8; no DURA.
sources: Fixed source Gaussian prior, corruption gate and frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Channel regressor training commit 0831bcec99be5d2e3d20aa093a674a5eed6eb68d and unroll training commit 7d9c8570361db942713359149c4b2e46be06281b; exact source fit IDs and view assignments equal.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Source only; DURA absent from candidate; fixed evaluation before source validation or target results. Prior model training running at registration.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed source validation with 3 correction strengths and 2 gates, per-record predictions before aggregation, no target. Compare also to stored unrolled source predictions; full candidate ground test always required.

execution.gpu_policy: CPU two threads, CUDA disabled; source smoke then immutable prediction arrays and checksum

execution.stop_rule: Stop only for provenance or role violation, output collision, nonfinite values or technical failure; preserve partial output; never stop for low performance

metric_names: per receiver and scenario clean-F pseudo target agreement
dimensions: RX4/6 validation and RX8 source heldout across seven scenarios; two input gates
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Fixed source clean-F pseudo targets, 126 RX/scene/gate/strength cells; compare paired unrolled source decisions, no TX truth or target. Ground test always fixed full model.

rows.purpose: evaluate source-supervised blind channel and unrolled waveform recovery together
rows.seed_notes: Prior model seed 2026125054; fixed final epoch8; no source validation training.
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes
rows.budget_ref: 7840 RX4/6 plus 3921 RX8 source records; three blends and two gates

notes: Candidate and full seven-view ground test fixed before learned-channel source validation or target results; prior source diagnostics and ground development tests previously observed.
No DURA architecture, weights, teacher or inference in candidate; DURA only as comparator where applicable.
Channel regressor uses received IQ and blind parent only; source clean IQ used for channel training and source evaluation, never as deployed input.
Ground evaluation uses CPU eight threads and checks raw F against fixed GPU baseline on every batch before truth; source validation CPU two threads.
Repeated simulated Phase1 development test, single seed; not independent blind or real satellite.
